component.name: Chute
component.summary: Send and receive files over Tailscale

description.p: A desktop front end for Taildrop. Linux has no built-in Taildrop receiver, so incoming files sit in the Tailscale inbox until something collects them. This runs a receiver in the background and drops arrivals into a folder you choose.
Sending works from the window or straight from a file manager: a "Send with Taildrop" submenu is added to Nautilus and Dolphin, with one entry per online device.
Requires Tailscale to be installed and running on the host.
First release: send, background receive, and file manager integration.
